faq.q: Which package should I start with?
faq.a: Start where you lose the most customers. If people can’t find you, start with the GBP Content Refresh. If they find you but don’t reach out, start with a website. If you’re not sure, the free Growth Audit will tell you.

faq.q: How much does it cost to get started?
faq.a: Local content and Google Business Profile work starts at $400. A Webflow or Shopify website starts at $800. A website with on-site photo/video capture starts at $2,000. Larger, multi-location projects start at $3,000.

It is the minimum published price for a tightly scoped version of the service. The final quote depends on your pages, content needs, shoot duration, locations and deliverables; we confirm the scope and total with you before starting.

faq.q: Can you quote a $1,200 small-business website or a $2,500 website and shoot?
faq.a: Yes. Those are examples of expanded project scopes above the minimum. We discuss your goals and existing assets, then quote only the work you need.
Content + Growth starts at $450 per month. A larger monthly plan with regular on-site shooting and more deliverables may cost more; the exact scope and rate are agreed before you subscribe.

faq.q: Do I need a new website to work with SWFT?
faq.a: No. Start with a Google Business Profile/content refresh or a monthly content plan if your existing site is already doing its job.

faq.q: Are ads and third-party subscriptions included?
faq.a: Ad spend, Webflow or Shopify subscriptions, domains and other third-party fees are separate unless specifically included in your written proposal. Full Growth Partner management starts at $1,200 per month before ad spend.
One-time projects are scoped per engagement. Ongoing content retainers are month-to-month under the agreed scope.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Timing depends on the assets you supply, page count, shoot schedule, feedback and approval turnaround. We confirm a realistic timeline during intake.

howItWorks.title: What happens after you pick a package

steps.title: Choose a package, or start with the free audit
steps.text: Not sure which stage is costing you most? The Free Growth Audit tells you, with no call and no pressure to buy.

steps.title: We confirm scope, timeline and total in writing
steps.text: Your pages, shoot time, locations and deliverables are itemized first. Nothing starts until you approve it.

steps.title: We build and shoot
steps.text: Timing depends on the assets you supply, page count, shoot schedule and how quickly feedback comes back. We confirm a realistic timeline during intake.

steps.title: You review and request changes
steps.text: Every package includes the consolidated revision round(s) listed above, so feedback is gathered once and handled together.

steps.title: We launch and deliver
steps.text: Sites go live with launch assistance. Photos and videos are delivered as listed. Monthly plans repeat each month under the same scope.
